# testdata/

`sample.itch` is a tiny hand-built ITCH 5.0 day: 17 messages, two symbols. It's generated by
[scripts/make_sample_itch.py](../scripts/make_sample_itch.py) and used by both the C++ tests
(`cpp/tests/test_replayer.cpp`) and the Python tests (`python/tests/test_replayer.py`), so
both layers are checked against the same expected values.

Prices below are in dollars, written as size @ price. On the wire they are integers with 4
implied decimals, so $10.00 is 100000.

## Expected books, sampled every second (depth 2)

A snapshot at time *t* includes every message with timestamp ≤ *t*. Messages at exactly
11 s, 12 s and 13 s therefore appear in that second's snapshot.

| t (s) | AAA bids | AAA asks | BBB bids | BBB asks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1–9 | – | – | – | – |
| 10 | 100 @ 10.00 | – | – | – |
| 11 | 100 @ 10.00, 200 @ 9.99 | 100 @ 10.01, 50 @ 10.02 | 100 @ 49.95 | 300 @ 50.00 |
| 12 | 150 @ 9.99 | 100 @ 10.01, 50 @ 10.02 | 100 @ 49.95 | 300 @ 50.00 |
| 13–15 | 150 @ 9.99 | 100 @ 10.01, 80 @ 10.015 | – | 300 @ 50.00 |

## Expected trades

`side` is the aggressor: +1 means a buyer took liquidity, −1 a seller.

| t (s) | Symbol | Kind | Price | Shares | Side | Match |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11.0 | AAA | E | 10.01 | 50 | +1 | 1001 |
| 12.0 | AAA | C | 9.995 | 100 | −1 | 1002 |
| 13.5 | BBB | P | 49.98 | 25 | +1 | 1003 |
| 14.0 | AAA | Q | 10.00 | 1000 | 0 | 1004 |
